messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: KV allocator fragmentation alert for prod-us-west-2 - fragmentation_ratio=0.91, arena_free_pages falling fast. Auto-escalation to #incidents and current oncall.
oncall-bot: Incident ID INC-2026 created. Severity=P1.
Alex P: seeing a rapid increase in kv cache size and continuous-batching adaptive growth. Allocator logs show many small allocations and failed cudaMallocs.
Alex P: logs excerpt:
Alex P: ```
E pytorch: cudaRuntimeError(2): out of memory when allocating 256MB (alloc.cc:415)
W kv_arena: slab_split_attempts=487, split_success=12, fragmentation=0.91
I batching: adaptive window increased batch_tokens 128 -> 1024 over 40s
```
Maria S: customer-facing metrics: p95 latency from 200ms -> 1.1s in 10m; error rates stable but timeouts and client retries increased. KV hit-rate dropped ~12%.
Customer Ops: we have two active customer tickets reporting elevated latencies (PaymentsCo and MediaCorp). No 5xxs observed, but PaymentsCo saw timed-out requests and opened a high-priority ticket.
Jin K: is there a quick mitigation to stop alloc growth? can we throttle batching or disable adaptive sizing?
Alex P: provisional mitigation: flipping continuous batching to static mode for affected model groups and region. Command run:
Alex P: ```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/api/config -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"scope":"prod-us-west-2","key":"batching.adaptive.enabled","value":false}'
```
Alex P: change applied at 2123456810. Monitoring: allocation churn slowed but fragmentation still high.
Leo T: enabling arena compaction on the cluster to consolidate free pages. Patch queued as PR #3821. Compaction config applied to canary nodes first.
Leo T: compaction snippet:
Leo T: ```yaml
kv_arena:
  compaction_enabled: true
  compaction_window_seconds: 60
  compaction_target_utilization: 0.65
```
Jin K: can compaction trigger latency spikes due to CPU or page migrations? we should canary and watch p99.
Maria S: canary results (node-3 of 8): short CPU bump (~6%) during compaction run and a transient p99 increase ~50-80ms, then p99 returned to baseline and fragmentation decreased ~0.15 absolute.
SRE Rotation: handoff note: current oncall window ends at 2200 UTC. Leaving this for next oncall. Key watch: kv_fragmentation_ratio, p95 latency, and cuda OOM logs.
Alex P: further mitigation: limit per-request tokens and set batching.max_tokens=256 for 'redwood-small' in prod-us-west-2. Pushed at 2123456865.
Alex P: config payload:
Alex P: ```json
{"model_group":"redwood-small","batching":{"max_tokens":256}}
```
DevOps Bot: PR 3821 canary rollout started (1/8 nodes) for compaction. CI passed.
Customer Ops: PaymentsCo reported partial improvement; p95 dropped from ~1.1s -> ~420ms after batching disabled. They requested an ETA for full recovery.
Jin K: rough ETA: if compaction stabilizes and adaptive batching stays off, expect steady state in ~30-45 minutes; give 60 minutes for full verification and customer follow-up.
Alex P: capturing verbose allocator traces to logs for postmortem: /var/log/kv/allocator-verbose-212345.log. Will keep 10 minutes of data for analysis.
Alex P: tail sample shows frequent non-coalescing frees and repeated small splits:
Alex P: ```
[alloc] free 64k chunk at 0x7fa... not merged with neighbor (flags=0x4)
[alloc] split slab 2->3 for request 48k, leaving tiny leftover 2k fragments
```
Leo T: hypothesis: recent allocator tuning in v2.14.0 changed eager-split thresholds and disabled coalescing heuristics under certain workloads, which interacts poorly with adaptive batching's sudden large token aggregation. Repro on staging with a batch growth workload.
Jin K: action items: (1) keep adaptive batching disabled in prod-us-west-2 until allocator patch lands; (2) run PR 3799 (allocator pin) to staging+soak; (3) extend compaction playbook with safety throttle; (4) notify customers with timeline and postmortem plan.
SRE Rotation: handoff checklist for next oncall: 1) verify batching.adaptive.enabled == false in prod-us-west-2 2) watch kv_fragmentation_ratio > 0.88 alert 3) monitor p95/p99 and customer tickets 4) be ready to rollback PR 3821 if CPU or latency regressions exceed thresholds.
DevOps Bot: PR 3799 created to pin allocator defaults; CI shows unit tests passed, integration queued.
Maria S: added temporary alert: kv_fragmentation_ratio > 0.85 for 5m and p95 > 800ms for 10m. Also updated INC-2026 incident doc with timeline and mitigation steps: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026
Customer Ops: PaymentsCo acknowledged our ETA and asked for a short summary they can share with their infra team.
Alex P: sent PaymentsCo a short note: we identified an allocator fragmentation regression triggered by adaptive batching growth; we disabled adaptive batching for your region and enabled compaction; expected full stabilization within 60m; we will follow up with a postmortem.
Jin K: I'll draft the postmortem and root cause analysis. Tagging @LeoT and @MariaS for allocator metric deep-dive. Draft ETA EOD.
Alex P: leaving verbose logs and the canary compaction trace for next oncall: /var/log/kv/allocator-verbose-212345.log, compaction traces stored in telemetry run 212345-compact-1.
SRE Rotation: last state: canary compaction healthy, adaptive batching off, fragmentation trending down (0.91 -> 0.76). Handoff: escalate immediately if kv_fragmentation_ratio > 0.88 or p95 > 1.5s.
DevOps Bot: incident INC-2026 acknowledged at 2123456820; last update posted at 2123456948.
Alex P: signing off from pager. Next oncall, please continue monitoring and coordinate the allocator patch rollout.
Jin K: thanks all — will own the postmortem and action tracking. Closing notes in the incident doc and will schedule follow-up meeting with infra team.
